label: Tent cities everywhere and no middle class left
description: In an open-eyed vision while driving around Oklahoma he sees poverty worse than anything in America before: tent cities like Skid Row but everywhere, no middle class at all, only poor, extreme poor and rich, with armed security around rich houses because of looting and a Robin Hood hatred of the wealthy.

label: Streets where a woman cannot walk at night
description: Streets that currently hold malls and good restaurants become places where a woman could not go at night at all, given alongside a woe over America for the prosperity it was granted.
aliases: you could not be a woman and go down these streets
I have held you in my hand

label: Masses leave the cities and pillage stores and farms
description: People fleeing the cities in masses for rural land and places of getaway, pillaging grocery stores, farmers fields and tractors, in scenes he compares to Mad Max.
aliases: something out of a Mad Max movie

label: The church as a beautiful apple rotten at the core
description: The church in America shown as a gorgeous, juicy apple that is black and putrid at the core, the rot only reached after several bites, given as the reason revival is being withheld. Unfalsifiable in form: the rot is by definition hidden under a healthy exterior.
aliases: it was rotten in the core
the fruit of the church as a whole

label: The printing press turned on and artificial money poured in
description: Houses seized as people cannot pay, and the president turning the printing press on with so much artificial money because they know the Titanic is sinking and cannot stop it, while telling the public everything is fine.

label: Three men become the first trillionaires
description: Three individual men seen becoming the first trillionaires in the global economy, named on 6 August 2025 as a Saudi prince, Michael Saylor and BlackRock, and corrected two days later to an Emirati rather than a Saudi. The change of a named party is worth keeping, not smoothing over.
aliases: the first trillionaires in the global economy

label: A coffee bean shortage that closes stores
description: A shortage of coffee beans from something happening to the bushes, with fires, drought and pests named as possible causes, and a vision of a Starbucks shutting stores over the beans. Coffee prices had already hit record highs on Brazilian drought when this was given.
aliases: the bushes with the berries for coffee

label: Major sports teams file bankruptcy and stadiums empty
description: Major sporting franchises file for bankruptcy and people stop going to stadiums, with the 76ers, the Philadelphia Eagles and the New York Jets named. No NFL or NBA franchise has ever filed for bankruptcy, which makes this unusually sharp.

label: A short window left before American broadcasts are cut off abroad
description: Only a little window remains before freedom of speech from America to other nations is shut down, naming the Japanese, South Korean and Chinese channels he broadcasts to, which is why he says he speaks with urgency.
aliases: a little bit of a window left

label: A strong Russia is needed for the hook in the jaw
description: The bear's head inflates like a beach ball, deflates, then the bear gains real strength, and he is told a strong Russia is required for the hook in the jaw of Ezekiel 38. No date attached, so it cannot expire.
aliases: the bear take a different role

label: The instruction not to strong-arm Putin, and the diffusing that followed
description: He says the instruction not to strong-arm Putin was given in prayer beforehand, that the president followed it at the Alaska meeting, that he had previously seen an arrogant strong-arming approach, and that he saw a diffusing inside Putin immediately. The meeting had already happened and been televised when this was said.
aliases: You better not try to strongarm him

label: France, Germany, Italy, the UK and Canada want the war for their economies
description: Five countries named as wanting the war because their economies are in trouble and war is what funds and stabilises an economy, with their representatives coming to Washington on the Monday to tell Trump he is siding with Putin. The 18 August 2025 White House meeting was already scheduled and reported.
aliases: France uh Germany, Italy, United Kingdom and Canada want war

label: A purple storm to the east over all Europe
description: Seen from outside the White House: a great storm to the east, purple over all of Europe with thunder and lightning, sun and beautiful rays on the near side, and an opportunity to diffuse it, tied to the plans for the following day.
aliases: All over Europe, I see purple

label: If the deal is refused the war escalates very rapidly
description: Zelensky and the European leaders seen throwing a fit over the decisions, and if they do not take the deal the war escalates very rapidly. He rates the clarity of this vision unusually high, saying there is no fog to it at all.
aliases: If they do not take this deal
There's no fog to it at all

label: The war as a money laundering machine, twenty four billion and child trafficking
description: Corruption in the finances around Ukraine, the figure twenty four billion, money laundering and big fraud with more to lose if the war ends, Zelensky in the middle of it like a drug dealer, and child trafficking running through the same operation.
aliases: The war machine is a money laundering machine
there's child trafficking involved in this

label: Famous people falling over dead in the middle of the act
description: Hollywood figures, sports figures and European soccer players falling over dead from heart attacks and strokes in the middle of the act, because the cup of sin is full over what is being done to girls under eighteen. Cardiac deaths among footballers are already documented every year, so only an unusual cluster would count.
aliases: falling over dead in the middle of the act
The cup of sin is full

label: Trafficking on the I-35 corridor exposed on the news
description: An exposing of child trafficking along I-35 from Oklahoma City up through Dallas Fort Worth to Kansas, involving truckers, semi trucks and hotels, with many children rescued and the story reaching the news. I-35 has been publicly described as a trafficking corridor for over a decade.
aliases: a trafficking of truckers is about to be exposed

label: Sting operations in a named list of cities
description: Major sting operations in the days ahead in cities flashing before him: Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Tampa, Denver, Kansas City, St Louis, Chicago, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Las Vegas, New Orleans and Little Rock, with Amarillo, Albuquerque and Texas college students added later in the same session. The large metros run such operations annually; Amarillo and Albuquerque are the specific ones.
aliases: These are the cities that are flashing before me

label: A 7.7 earthquake in the heart of India
description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake in the middle of India, given as a number he saw, beginning a great shaking that spreads through Vietnam and all of China and out of which a great revival is birthed. Central India is a stable craton with no recorded event of that size; India's large earthquakes occur on the Himalayan front.
aliases: the beginning of a great shaking
